Geospatial Inequality in the Green Transition: Pollution Redistribution from Electric Vehicles
abstract: Electric vehicles (EVs) are widely recognized to deliver environmental benefits by replacing tailpipe emissions with electricity. This paper shows that when electricity generation remains coal-intensive, EV adoption reduces urban air pollution but also redistributes it across space. Using monthly city-level comprehensive vehicle registration data and satellite-based pollution measures around power plants in China, we find that EV adoption reduces urban pollution while increasing pollution exposure near coal-fired power plants. The results are robust to extensive controls and instrumental-variable estimates based on charging-station expansion. We further use a new method that incorporates interregional electricity transmission, addressing a major challenge in identifying the causal environmental impacts of electrification. Pollution displacement generates both intra-city and inter-city environmental inequality, with roughly two-thirds arising across cities and one-third within cities, highlighting the importance of power-sector decarbonization in evaluating the environmental justice implications of EV adoption.
abstract_zh: 电动汽车（EV）通过以电力替代尾气排放，被广泛认为能带来环境效益。本文表明，当发电仍以煤炭为主时，电动汽车的普及虽然降低了城市空气污染，却也使污染在空间上发生了再分配。利用中国城市层面的月度综合车辆登记数据，以及发电厂周边基于卫星的污染测量数据，我们发现，电动汽车的普及在降低城市污染的同时，增加了燃煤电厂附近的污染暴露。在纳入大量控制变量后，结果依然稳健；基于充电站扩张的工具变量估计也支持这一结论。我们进一步采用一种纳入区域间电力输送的新方法，解决了识别电气化的因果环境影响这一重大挑战。污染转移既产生了城市内部的环境不平等，也产生了城市之间的环境不平等，其中约三分之二发生在城市之间，三分之一发生在城市内部，这突出表明，在评估电动汽车普及的环境正义影响时，电力行业脱碳十分重要。

Carbon Markets Promote Environmental Justice in China
abstract: Environmental markets may influence environmental justice by disproportionately affecting economically disadvantaged or socially vulnerable communities. We investigate the impact of China’s Certified Emission Reduction (CCER) program on air pollution in disadvantaged and non-disadvantaged counties from 2000 to 2019. We find that the CCER program effectively reduces carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions and fine particulate matter (PM2.5) concentrations. We further examine the distributional impacts and find that the program promotes environmental justice by reducing disparities in air quality between economically disadvantaged and more affluent counties, as well as between ethnic minority and majority (Han) counties. In particular, we observe greater improvements in air quality and more equitable outcomes from renewable energy projects. Our findings offer policy-relevant insights for designing environmental markets that advance sustainable development and social equity in China and other regions. China’s CCER carbon offset program is associated with reductions in CO₂ emissions and PM₂.₅ concentrations, helping to narrow the air pollution gap between economically disadvantaged and more affluent counties, as well as between ethnic minority and Han counties.
abstract_zh: 环境市场可能会对经济弱势群体或社会脆弱社区产生不成比例的影响，从而关系到环境正义。我们考察了中国核证减排量（CCER）计划对2000至2019年间弱势县与非弱势县空气污染的影响。我们发现，CCER计划有效减少了二氧化碳（CO2）排放和细颗粒物（PM2.5）浓度。我们进一步考察了分配效应，发现该计划通过缩小经济弱势县与较富裕县之间，以及少数民族县与汉族县之间的空气质量差距，促进了环境正义。特别是，我们观察到可再生能源项目带来了更大的空气质量改善和更为公平的结果。我们的发现为设计能够推动可持续发展与社会公平的环境市场提供了与政策相关的启示，适用于中国及其他地区。中国CCER碳抵消计划与二氧化碳排放量和PM₂.₅浓度的降低相关联，有助于缩小经济弱势县与较富裕县之间，以及少数民族县与汉族县之间的空气污染差距。

title: Enrollment Restrictions and Conservation Practice Adoptions by Midwestern Farmers: Survey Evidence from Iowa
abstract: Using a mixed-mode survey of 424 farmer respondents in the Boone and North Raccoon River watersheds in Iowa, we examine the influence of enrollment restrictions on farmers’ preferences for conservation practices using a discrete choice experiment and a random parameters logit model. Our findings indicate prospective farmer participants favor conservation contracts with enrollment requirements on new, additional practices. Comparisons with EQIP reveal decreased mean willingness-to-accept for cover crops, no-till, and split nitrogen application contracts—by 55%, 69%, and 52%— with enrollment restrictions, respectively. In addition, participation supply curves also demonstrate higher enrollment, though this is especially true for low compensation levels.
abstract_zh: 本研究利用对爱荷华州Boone和North Raccoon River流域424名农民受访者进行的混合模式调查，采用离散选择实验和随机参数logit模型，考察了入组限制对农民保护性耕作措施偏好的影响。我们的研究结果表明，潜在的农民参与者偏好那些对新增实践设有入组要求的保护合同。与环境质量激励计划（EQIP）相比，对于覆盖作物、免耕和分次施氮合同，设有入组限制时，其平均受偿意愿分别下降了55%、69%和52%。此外，参与供给曲线也表明入组率更高，不过这在低补偿水平下尤为明显。

title: Information Rigidities and Farmland Value Expectations
abstract: This study examines the degree to which information inefficiency influences farmland price expectations. Using expectations and observed values of Iowa farmland from 1964 to 2021 and the empirical test of Coibion and Gorodnichenko (2015), this study estimates the degree to which information rigidities hold explanatory power for information inefficiency. Our results suggest Iowa farmland professionals infrequently update their information set or underweight new information. This study provides a necessary step toward a better understanding of the role of information in farmland market efficiency, furthering the discussion of development of additional public information in farmland markets.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了信息低效率在多大程度上影响农田价格预期。利用1964年至2021年爱荷华州农田的预期值和实际观测值，并采用Coibion与Gorodnichenko（2015）的实证检验，本研究估计了信息刚性在解释信息低效率方面的解释力程度。我们的结果表明，爱荷华州的农田专业人士很少更新其信息集，或对新信息赋予了过低的权重。本研究为更好地理解信息在农田市场效率中的作用迈出了必要的一步，并推动了关于在农田市场中开发更多公共信息的讨论。

title: Is There an Extension Discount for Agricultural Economics Faculty?
abstract: Salary is an important aspect of one’s decision to pursue a particular career. This work compares the salaries of Agricultural Economics faculty members with and without Extension responsibilities across 19 departments in the US. We find that mean salaries for those with Extension appointments are significantly less than those without Extension appointments, ranging from a difference of $5,065 for assistant professors to $14,532 for full professors. We encourage administrators to acknowledge this “Extension Discount” and, if desired, make intentional decisions to reduce it. Doing so would serve to address recruiting challenges for Agricultural Economics Extension positions.
abstract_zh: 薪酬是人们选择特定职业时的重要考量。本文比较了美国19个院系中，承担推广（Extension）职责与不承担推广职责的农业经济学教师的薪酬。我们发现，有推广职位者的平均薪酬显著低于无推广职位者，差距从助理教授的5,065美元到正教授的14,532美元不等。我们建议管理者正视这一“推广折扣”，并在认为必要时有意识地减少这一折扣。这样做将有助于应对农业经济学推广岗位招聘中面临的挑战。

title: Rice Farming for Climate Change Adaptation in the Northeastern United States
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: In response to challenges posed by climate change, rice farming emerges as a strategic adaptation in the agriculture sector in the northeastern United States. Cultivating rice can diversify farming practices, create new sources of income, improve water management, and provide habitats for wildlife, enhancing the sustainability of agricultural systems and rural economies. However, challenges such as methane emissions from rice paddies and the risk of metal(loid) contamination highlight the need for adopting best practices in rice cultivation, particularly in land and water management and the selection of suitable rice varieties. By learning from the experience of other temperate rice farming regions and implementing supportive policies, technology, and cooperative frameworks, farming communities in the northeastern United States can learn to navigate these obstacles, ensuring the successful integration of rice farming into its agricultural landscape.
abstract_zh: 面对气候变化带来的挑战，水稻种植正成为美国东北部农业部门一项具有战略意义的适应措施。种植水稻可以使耕作方式多样化，创造新的收入来源，改善水资源管理，并为野生动物提供栖息地，从而增强农业系统和农村经济的可持续性。然而，稻田产生的甲烷排放以及金属（类金属）污染风险等挑战，凸显了采用水稻种植最佳实践的必要性，尤其是在土地和水资源管理以及合适水稻品种的选择方面。通过借鉴其他温带水稻种植区的经验，并实施相应的支持性政策、技术和合作框架，美国东北部的农业社区能够学会应对这些障碍，确保水稻种植成功融入其农业景观。

title: The Impact of China's Place-Based Environmental Regulations on Its Hog Industry: A Synthetic Difference-in-Differences Approach
abstract: Agricultural water pollution from the livestock industry is a growing concern in China and globally. Since 2014, China classified eight urban provinces in the southeast as a Development Control Zone (DCZ), which prohibits new hog facility construction and encourages hog farms to relocate to other regions. Leveraging synthetic difference-in-differences (SDID), we systematically analyze the impacts of such place-based regulations on the hog industry and water pollution, especially revealing heterogeneous responses. Our results show that, on average, the regulations led to heterogeneous reductions in hog inventories both within and across DCZ provinces, mainly resulting from the closures of existing hog farms. The effects range from a 2% increase to 40% hog inventory reduction, equivalent to a loss of over U.S. $5.06 billion in the DCZ hog sectoral revenue. We explore three channels to explain the heterogeneity: counties upstream of big cities, counties designated as main hog counties, and counties with drinking water sources serve as origins of the heterogeneous effects. However, we find no significant water quality improvement.
abstract_zh: 畜牧业造成的农业水污染，在中国乃至全球都日益受到关注。自2014年以来，中国将东南部的八个城市化省份划定为发展控制区（DCZ），禁止新建生猪养殖设施，并鼓励养猪场迁往其他地区。利用双重差分合成控制法（SDID），我们系统分析了此类基于地点的监管措施对生猪产业和水污染的影响，尤其揭示了其异质性反应。结果表明，总体而言，这些监管措施导致发展控制区内外的生猪存栏量出现异质性减少，主要源于现有养猪场的关闭。影响幅度从生猪存栏量增加2%到减少40%不等，相当于发展控制区生猪产业收入损失超过50.6亿美元。我们探讨了三种渠道来解释这种异质性：位于大城市上游的县、被指定为主要生猪产区的县，以及拥有饮用水水源的县，它们是异质性效应的来源。然而，我们并未发现水质有显著改善。

title: The Impacts of the 2025 Trade Wars on Global Agricultural Markets and US Agricultural Trade
venue: International Food and Agribusiness Management Review
abstract: This paper assesses the economic consequences of the 2025 U.S. trade policy on global agricultural markets, with a focus on the “reciprocal tariffs” initiated by the United States. By using a multi-region, multi-sector computable general equilibrium model, we evaluate the macroeconomic and sectoral effects of alternative tariff scenarios, with a particular focus on the U.S. agricultural sector. Our results indicate that the imposition of uniform tariffs on U.S. imports from the rest of the world generates substantial welfare losses for the U.S. (0.63%) and China (1.28%), with corresponding GDP declines of 0.82 and 0.39%, respectively. Tariffs result in significant contractions in global agricultural trade and higher consumer prices for key agri-food products in the US, including vegetables (6.05%), crops (7.48%), and cattle (4.13%). China’s oilseed imports from the U.S. decrease by 38.32%, while imports from Canada and Brazil increase by 17.48 and 3.92%, respectively, if U.S.–China tariffs are enacted. U.S. imports of high-value vegetables and fruits from Canada and Mexico decline sharply, partially offset by increased imports from Australia and Argentina if new tariffs are enacted in North America. These findings show the complex sectoral adjustments and market realignments driven by escalating trade tensions.
abstract_zh: 本文评估了2025年美国贸易政策对全球农产品市场的经济后果，重点关注美国发起的“对等关税”。通过使用多地区、多部门可计算一般均衡模型，我们评估了不同关税情景的宏观经济和部门效应，并特别关注美国农业部门。结果表明，对美国从世界其他地区进口的商品统一征收关税，将使美国（0.63%）和中国（1.28%）的福利遭受重大损失，其GDP分别下降0.82%和0.39%。关税导致全球农产品贸易显著收缩，并使美国关键农产品价格上涨，包括蔬菜（6.05%）、作物（7.48%）和牛（4.13%）。若启动中美关税，中国自美国进口的油籽将减少38.32%，而自加拿大和巴西的进口则分别增加17.48%和3.92%。若在北美实施新关税，美国自加拿大和墨西哥进口的高价值蔬菜和水果将大幅下降，部分被自澳大利亚和阿根廷的进口增长所抵消。这些发现表明，不断升级的贸易紧张局势正在引发复杂的部门调整和市场重组。

title: Carbon Emissions from Household Energy Use in Pakistan: Policy Implications for Climate Mitigation and Regional Development
Institutional Land Ownership and Conservation Practice Adoption in the US Midwest
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: We study how a firm's institutional ownership structure influences its adoption of environmentally beneficial innovations. This question is salient in the U.S. agricultural sector, where corporate structures like LLCs and trusts are becoming more prevalent. Nationally, institutional farmland ownership is growing and attracting new producers, yet its net impact on conservation remains ambiguous. Using representative panel data of landowners from Iowa—a state with surging institutional ownership from 9% to 38% between 1982 and 2022 —we analyze the adoption of no-till and cover crops, practices crucial for soil health and climate resilience. Employing a bivariate Tobit model with an instrumental variable of long-term capital gains tax liability to address endogeneity, results indicate institutional ownership significantly boosts conservation. It increases the likelihood and acreage of no-till adoption by 31.7% and 31.8%, and cover crops by 41.7% and 28.8%, respectively. Key drivers include professional management, access to information, and structured farm transitions.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了企业的机构所有权结构如何影响其采用有利于环境的创新。这一问题在美国农业部门尤为突出，因为有限责任公司（LLC）和信托等公司形式正日益普遍。在全国范围内，机构持有的农田比例不断增长，并吸引了新的生产者，但其对保护的净影响仍不明确。我们利用爱荷华州具有代表性的土地所有者面板数据（该州机构所有权在1982年至2022年间从9%激增至38%），分析了免耕和覆盖作物的采用情况，这两种做法对土壤健康和气候韧性至关重要。我们采用双变量Tobit模型，并以长期资本利得税负债作为工具变量以解决内生性问题，结果表明机构所有权显著促进了保护性做法。它使免耕的采用可能性和面积分别提高了31.7%和31.8%，使覆盖作物的采用可能性和面积分别提高了41.7%和28.8%。主要驱动因素包括专业化管理、信息获取，以及有组织的农场过渡。

By How Much Can Appraised Farm Values Differ Across Appraisers?
venue: Journal of the American Society of Farm Managers and Rural Appraisers
abstract: We compared 54 appraisal reports, completed by nine Certified General Appraisers (CGAs) for three Iowa farms at two points in time (2019 and 2020), to evaluate the variability of appraised values and its causes. Our findings confirm that, despite the norms and regulations that CGAs abide by, the appraisal process is subjective in nature, and appraised values can differ by as much as 20% of their average appraised values. Furthermore, observed discrepancies in basic facts considered by CGAs to form their expert opinions on the value of a farm, such as tillable acres and productivity indexes, are non-trivial.
abstract_zh: 我们比较了由九名注册通用评估师（CGA）针对爱荷华州三个农场在两个时间点（2019年和2020年）完成的54份评估报告，以评估评估值的变异性及其成因。我们的研究发现证实，尽管CGA需遵守相关规范与法规，评估过程本质上仍具有主观性，评估值可能与其平均评估值相差多达20%。此外，CGA在形成农场价值专家意见时所依据的基本事实（如可耕作英亩数和生产力指数）也存在明显差异，且这些差异不可忽略。

title: Designated Market Makers and Agricultural Futures Market Quality: Evidence from China's Dalian Commodity Exchange
abstract: Many financial markets use designated market makers (DMMs), but the impacts of DMMs on agricultural futures markets – and in particular, how to arrange DMMs among contracts expiring in different months – are largely neglected. In 2017, Chinese exchanges started recruiting DMMs for inactive contracts when they become nearby contracts to address the discontinuous trading activity of nearest‐to‐maturity contracts, which enables us to study the benefit and cost of recruiting DMMs for inactive contracts using a quasi‐experimental framework. Leveraging tick‐by‐tick data on corn and soybean meal futures, we find that DMMs improve the market quality of inactive contracts without disrupting the market quality of dominant contracts. Heterogeneity analysis in policy settings suggests that more DMMs are conducive to improving market quality for corn and soybean meal futures. We demonstrate that DMM policy is a feasible measure to facilitate continuous activeness in Chinese agricultural futures markets. Our results are important for exchanges and regulators seeking to better design and implement designated market‐making programs in agricultural futures markets.
abstract_zh: 许多金融市场采用指定做市商（DMM），但指定做市商对农产品期货市场的影响，尤其是如何在不同到期月份的合约之间安排指定做市商，在很大程度上被忽视了。2017年，中国的交易所开始为不活跃合约在成为近月合约时招募指定做市商，以应对临近到期合约交易活动不连续的问题，这使我们能够利用准实验框架研究为不活跃合约招募指定做市商的收益与成本。利用玉米和豆粕期货的逐笔数据，我们发现，指定做市商提高了不活跃合约的市场质量，同时并未扰乱主力合约的市场质量。政策情境下的异质性分析表明，指定做市商越多，越有利于提高玉米和豆粕期货的市场质量。我们证明，指定做市商政策是促进中国农产品期货市场持续活跃的可行措施。我们的结论对于希望在农产品期货市场中更好地设计和实施指定做市计划的交易所和监管者具有重要意义。

title: Evaluating the Tradeoff between Cost-Effectiveness and Participation in Agricultural Conservation Programs
abstract: Using a survey of 430 farmer respondents in the Boone and North Raccoon River watersheds in Iowa, we examine the impacts of three program innovations—reverse auctions, spatially targeted payments, and higher offered payments—on agricultural conservation program cost effectiveness and participation by farmers. We combine farmer responses to a discrete choice experiment offering voluntary conservation contracts with township‐level estimates of per‐acre nitrogen reductions from each practice derived from the process‐based ecohydrological Soil and Water Assessment Tool model. Using a random‐parameters logit model, we show that both cost‐reducing and benefit‐boosting interventions reduce budgetary costs per projected pound of nitrogen removed from the watershed for each practice and thus are more cost effective than the prevailing current cost‐share programs. However, we find that these interventions can reduce participation by 30%–70%. Our policy simulations show that even with large budgets, the watershed‐level nitrogen reduction from all policy interventions remains far below the policy targets set by the Iowa Nutrient Reduction Strategy. Furthermore, we find cover crop contracts are far more cost effective than no‐till/strip‐till split nitrogen application contracts.
abstract_zh: 利用对爱荷华州Boone和North Raccoon River流域430名农民受访者的调查，我们考察了三项项目创新（逆向拍卖、空间定向支付和更高的补偿支付）对农业保护项目成本效益和农民参与度的影响。我们将农民对自愿保护合同的离散选择实验回应，与基于过程型生态水文模型（土壤和水评估工具，SWAT）得出的、各项措施在乡镇层面每亩氮减排量估计值相结合。采用随机参数logit模型，我们表明，成本削减型和效益提升型干预措施均降低了每从流域中去除一磅预计氮量的预算成本，因此比现行的成本分摊计划更具成本效益。然而，我们发现这些干预措施可能使参与率下降30%–70%。政策模拟显示，即使预算规模很大，所有政策干预措施带来的流域层面氮减排量仍远低于爱荷华州营养减排战略所设定的政策目标。此外，我们发现覆盖作物合约远比免耕/条带耕作分次施氮合约更具成本效益。

Uncovering Disparities in Water-Based Outdoor Recreation Using Cell Phone Mobility Data
abstract: Outdoor recreation plays a pivotal role in improving people’s physical and mental health, serving as a popular form of entertainment and a significant economic contributor. Limited access to these resources not only exacerbates health disparities but also deprives underserved areas of essential benefits like stress relief and community bonding, both of which are crucial for enhancing overall quality of life. This paper provides one of the first detailed analyses of water-based recreation at over 61 000 inland and coastal sites across the United States. We aim to explore disparities in recreational behavior across race, ethnicity, income, and socioeconomic status. Using Advan cellphone data from more than 70 million outdoor trips, representing 215 000 census block groups, we find that communities of color, rural areas, and socioeconomically disadvantaged groups are significantly underrepresented in water-based recreational visits. Despite living similar distances from recreational sites, these groups show notably different patterns in travel distance for water-based recreation. Additionally, we find Native Americans from underserved areas have to travel 3–5 times longer distances than other groups for water-based recreation. Our findings show that the extensive and frequent cellphone mobility data could reveal policy-relevant patterns especially those made by underserved Americans often overlooked in traditional household surveys.
abstract_zh: 户外休闲在促进人们身心健康方面发挥着关键作用，既是一种广受欢迎的娱乐形式，也是重要的经济贡献者。获取这些资源的机会有限，不仅加剧了健康不平等，还使弱势地区失去了缓解压力和增进社区联系等基本益处，而这两者对于提升整体生活质量至关重要。本文首次对美国超过6.1万个内陆和沿海水上休闲场所进行了较为详细的分析。我们旨在探讨不同种族、民族、收入和社会经济地位人群在休闲行为上的不平等。利用Advan提供的手机数据（来自超过7000万次户外出行，覆盖21.5万个人口普查街区组），我们发现，有色人种社区、农村地区以及社会经济弱势群体在水上休闲访问中的代表性明显不足。尽管这些群体与休闲场所的距离相近，但他们在水上休闲的出行距离模式上却表现出显著差异。此外，我们发现，来自服务不足地区的美洲原住民为进行水上休闲，所需出行距离是其他群体的3至5倍。我们的研究结果表明，广泛而频繁的手机移动数据能够揭示与政策相关的规律，特别是那些常被传统家庭调查所忽视的、服务不足的美国人的出行模式。

title: What Midwest Farmers Think about the Trade Dispute with China: Concerns, Claims, Solutions, and Information Needs
What Women Landowners Want to Know about Conservation?
abstract: Women own or co-own almost half of the land in the US Midwest and women landowners are playing an increasingly important role in production and financial decision-making. Despite their growing influence, women landowners are less engaged in conservation programs and networks, primarily due to inadequate access to conservation services and resources, leading to a scenario where men continue to dominate participation in both governmental and private conservation initiatives. The existing body of literature further echoes this disparity, with women's perspectives and voices markedly underrepresented in the United States' conservation discourse. Aiming to bridge this gap, this article delves into the attitudes of women landowners toward conservation using a 2021 survey conducted with 135 Iowa women landowners. The survey sought to shed light on their interests in various conservation topics, their concerns regarding conservation decision-making, and their preferences concerning the sources of information and the methods through which educational content is delivered. We find that women landowners are most interested in government conservation programs, followed by soil erosion control, soil fertilizer improvement, and cover crops. We provide statistical evidence that more women operating landowners are interested in conservation topics and concerned about conservation issues than women non-operating landowners in general. We further explore the variations in conservation interests among women landowners, considering their demographic and farm-specific characteristics, to highlight the diverse perspectives within this group. Additionally, we examine the preferred channels through which women landowners wish to receive educational information, offering valuable insights for policymaking and extension services. The results underscore a preference for a mix of delivery methods among women landowners, with a particular inclination toward virtual platforms, such as periodic (e-)newsletters and webinars, and printed materials such as fact sheets or infographics, over traditional in-person formats. This nuanced understanding of women landowners' educational preferences and conservation interests serves as a foundational step toward fostering more inclusive conservation programs and networks that effectively engage and represent women in the agricultural sector.
abstract_zh: 女性拥有或共同拥有美国中西部近一半的土地，女性土地所有者在生产和财务决策中发挥着日益重要的作用。尽管影响力不断增强，女性土地所有者在保护计划和网络中的参与度仍然较低，主要原因在于获得保护服务和资源的渠道不足，导致在政府和私人保护活动中，男性仍占据主导地位。现有文献也印证了这一差距，美国的保护性讨论中，女性的观点和声音明显缺失。为弥合这一鸿沟，本文利用2021年对135名爱荷华州女性土地所有者开展的调查，探讨了她们对保护的态度。该调查旨在揭示她们对各类保护议题的兴趣、对保护决策的关切，以及她们对信息来源和教育内容传递方式的偏好。我们发现，女性土地所有者最关注政府保护计划，其次是水土流失控制、土壤肥力改良和覆盖作物。我们提供统计证据表明，与非经营型女性土地所有者相比，经营型女性土地所有者总体上对保护议题更感兴趣，也更关注保护问题。我们进一步考察了女性土地所有者保护兴趣的差异，并结合其人口统计学和农场特征，以凸显该群体内部的多元视角。此外，我们考察了女性土地所有者希望接收教育信息的首选渠道，为政策制定和推广服务提供了有价值的启示。结果表明，女性土地所有者更倾向于多种传播方式相结合，尤其偏好定期（电子）通讯和网络研讨会等虚拟平台，以及情况说明书或信息图等印刷材料，而非传统的面对面形式。对女性土地所有者教育偏好和保护兴趣的细致理解，为促进更具包容性的保护计划和网络奠定了基础，使其能够切实吸纳和代表农业部门中的女性。

Disamenity or Premium: Do Electricity Transmission Lines Affect Farmland Values and Housing Prices Differently?
abstract: A substantial increase in electricity demand has triggered a rising investment in energy infrastructure in the US over the last decade. This paper examines the capitalization effects of electricity transmission lines (TMLs) on nearby farmland values and housing prices in the Midwest from 2015 to 2019, based on 16,026 parcel-level farmland sales data from FarmlandFinder and 1,905,280 housing transaction data from the Zillow Transaction and Assessment Dataset database. Our estimation results reaffirm the disamenity effects of TMLs on housing property values and find that the disamenity effects are larger on houses in urban areas than in rural areas. Nearby TMLs generate premiums for surrounding farmland, which contrasts with the disamenity evidence due to aesthetics (either visual or audible) in the literature. We further show that farmland parcels within 0–2 km of TMLs in high-wind areas are approximately 3.10% more expensive than comparable parcels in low-wind areas. Our paper provides novel and contrarian evidence on the effects of TMLs on property values amid rising investment in energy infrastructure.
abstract_zh: 过去十年间，美国电力需求大幅增长，引发了能源基础设施投资的持续上升。本文利用FarmlandFinder提供的16,026宗地块层面农田交易数据，以及Zillow交易与评估数据库中的1,905,280笔住房交易数据，考察了2015至2019年间中西部输电线路（TML）对周边农田价值和住房价格的资本化效应。我们的估计结果再次证实了输电线路对住房价值的负外部性（disamenity）效应，并发现这种负面效应在城市地区的住房上大于农村地区。附近的输电线路反而使周边农田产生溢价，这与文献中因美学（视觉或听觉）而产生负外部性的证据形成对比。我们进一步表明，在高风速地区、距输电线路0–2公里内的农田地块，比低风速地区的可比地块约贵3.10%。本文在能源基础设施投资不断增长的背景下，为输电线路对财产价值的影响提供了新颖且与直觉相反的证据。

title: Of Women and Land: How Gender Affects Successions and Transfers of Iowa Farms
abstract: Using 589 responses to the 2019 Iowa Farm Transfer Survey, we examine factors in farm successor choices among Iowa farmers with a focus on female successors and landowners. Among those with identified successors, 57% chose sons and 8% chose daughters. We find a 12.4% probability a female farmer will choose a daughter, but only 5.9% for a male farmer. Agriculture experience increases the probability of choosing a daughter from 5.4% to 20.7% and from 36.3% to 65.2% for a son. Our paper reveals striking evidence of gender imbalance in farm succession, transfer, and inheritance decisions of US farms.
abstract_zh: 本文利用2019年爱荷华州农场转让调查的589份回复，考察了爱荷华州农民选择农场继承人的影响因素，重点关注女性继承人和女性土地所有者。在已确定继承人的人中，57%选择儿子，8%选择女儿。我们发现，女性农场主选择女儿的概率为12.4%，而男性农场主仅为5.9%。农业经验将选择女儿的概率从5.4%提高到20.7%，将选择儿子的概率从36.3%提高到65.2%。本文揭示了美国农场在继承、转让和遗产决策中存在显著的性别失衡。

The Impacts of Interest Rate Changes on US Midwest Farmland Values
abstract:
Purpose
This paper quantifies the effects of recent Federal Reserve interest rate changes, specifically recent hikes and cuts in the federal funds rate since 2015, on Midwest farmland values.
Design/methodology/approach
The authors apply three autoregressive distributed lag (ARDL) models to a panel data of state-level farmland values from 1963 to 2018 to estimate the dynamic effects of interest rate changes on the US farmland market. We focus on the I-states, Lakes states and Great Plains states. The models in the study capture both short-term and long-term impacts of policy changes on land values.
Findings
The authors find that changes in the federal funds rate have long-lasting impacts on farmland values, as it takes at least a decade for the full effects of an interest rate change to be capitalized in farmland values. The results show that the three recent federal funds rate cuts in 2019 were not sufficient to offset the downward pressures from the 2015–2018 interest rate hikes, but the 2020 cut is. The combined effect of the Federal Reserve's recent interest rate moves on farmland values will be positive for some time starting in 2022.
Originality/value
This paper provides the first empirical quantification of the immediate and long-run impacts of recent Federal Reserve interest rate moves on farmland values. The authors demonstrate the long-lasting repercussions of Federal Reserve's policy choices in the farmland market.
abstract_zh:
目的
本文量化了美联储近期利率调整（具体而言是自2015年以来联邦基金利率的多次加息和降息）对中西部农田价值的影响。
设计/方法/途径
作者对1963年至2018年各州农田价值的面板数据应用了三种自回归分布滞后（ARDL）模型，以估计利率变动对美国农田市场的动态影响。我们关注I州组（I-states）、五大湖区州和大平原州。研究中的模型同时捕捉政策变化对土地价值的短期和长期影响。
研究发现
作者发现，联邦基金利率的变动对农田价值具有长期影响，利率变化的全部效应要完全反映到农田价值中，至少需要十年。结果显示，2019年的三次联邦基金利率下调不足以抵消2015–2018年加息带来的下行压力，但2020年的降息则足以抵消。美联储近期利率调整对农田价值的综合影响，将从2022年起的一段时间内转为正向。
原创性/价值
本文首次对美联储近期利率调整对农田价值的即时和长期影响进行了实证量化。作者展示了美联储政策选择在农田市场中的长期影响。

title: The Role of Regulations and Norms in Land Use Change
venue: Book chapter: Science for the Sustainable City: Empirical Insights from the Baltimore School of Urban Ecology
abstract: Human uses of land produce large social benefits in the form of food, fiber, shelter, and other essential goods and services, but they also generate a range of environmental impacts, including carbon emissions, soil and water degradation, alterations of habitat and hydrologic cycles, and loss of biodiversity. The scale of land use impacts has increased dramatically over time with growing global population and development. Many scientists believe that current global land use practices are undermining the Earth's long-term ability to sustain food production, freshwater and forest resources, and other provisioning ecosystem services. While these concerns are global, land use decisions occur in local settings in response to local, regional, and global factors. Thus, achieving more sustainable land use practices relies on policies that can effectively manage land use and land change processes at local and multiple scales. Because the impacts vary across space, an understanding of the spatial pattern of land use and land change at local scales is also important.
abstract_zh: 人类对土地的利用带来了巨大的社会效益，包括食物、纤维、住所及其他基本商品和服务，但同时也产生了一系列环境影响，包括碳排放、土壤和水体退化、栖息地和水文循环的改变以及生物多样性丧失。随着全球人口增长和发展，土地利用影响的规模急剧扩大。许多科学家认为，当前全球土地利用方式正在削弱地球长期维持粮食生产、淡水和森林资源以及其他供给型生态系统服务的能力。尽管这些担忧是全球性的，但土地利用决策是在地方环境中，针对地方、区域和全球因素而作出的。因此，实现更可持续的土地利用方式，依赖于能够在地方和多个尺度上有效管理土地利用及土地变化过程的政策。由于其影响因空间而异，因此在地方尺度上理解土地利用和土地变化的空间格局也同样重要。

title: What Drives Landowners' Conservation Decisions? Evidence from Iowa
venue: Journal of Soil and Water Conservation
abstract: Conservation practices such as no-till and cover crops have been shown to have on- and off-farm benefits. However, when benefits of a practice do not go to the provider, underinvestment may occur. Farmland rental arrangements where tenants may not reap the benefits of conservation investments are a commonly cited barrier to conservation practice adoption in agriculture and may result in lower adoption rates on rented land than on owner-operated fields. This issue is especially important since more than half of Midwestern farmland is rented out. This article examines the factors driving adoption of four key conservation practices—no-till, cover crops, buffer strips, and ponds/sediment basins—using a statistically representative survey of Iowa landowners. We find evidence supporting the hypothesis that adoption is lower on rented land for cover crops, buffer strips, and sediment basins, but not for no-till. Our results also show that the large proportion of the state’s land owned by nonoperating landowners and absentee landowners could present a barrier to increasing adoption of conservation practices. Furthermore, landowners seem open to increasing the use of cover crops in the immediate future, and a sizable number are even willing to incentivize tenants by paying for part of the cover crop planting cost. Finally, almost half of landowners would be willing to increase the area of their land under conservation practices if they could receive conservation-related tax credits or deductions, suggesting a potential policy strategy to increase adoption.
abstract_zh: 免耕和覆盖作物等保护措施已被证明具有场内和场外效益。然而，当某项措施的效益并不归于提供方时，就可能出现投资不足。在租赁农田安排中，承租人可能无法获得保护投资的收益，这一问题常被视为农业中采用保护措施的障碍，并可能导致租赁地的采用率低于自营田地。这一问题尤为重要，因为中西部一半以上的农田都被出租。本文利用爱荷华州土地所有者具有统计代表性的调查，考察了四项关键保护措施（免耕、覆盖作物、缓冲带以及池塘/沉沙池）的采用驱动因素。我们发现，对于覆盖作物、缓冲带和沉沙池而言，租赁土地上的采用率较低，这一假设得到了证据支持，但免耕则不然。我们的结果还表明，该州大部分土地由非经营型和缺席型土地所有者持有，这可能成为提高保护措施采用率的障碍。此外，土地所有者在不久的将来似乎愿意增加覆盖作物的使用，相当一部分人甚至愿意为承租人支付部分覆盖作物种植成本，以激励承租人。最后，如果能够获得与保护相关的税收抵免或扣除，近一半的土地所有者愿意增加其土地上保护措施的面积，这表明存在一种有助于提高采用率的潜在政策策略。

The Housing Market Bust and Farmland Values: Identifying the Changing Influence of Proximity to Urban Centers
abstract: This article estimates the impact of the 2007–2008 residential housing market bust on farmland values, using parcel-level farmland sales data from 2001–2010 for a 50-county region under urbanization pressure in western Ohio. Hedonic model estimates reveal that farmland was not immune to the residential housing bust; the portion of farmland value attributable to proximity to urban areas was almost cut in half shortly after the bust in 2009–2010. Nonetheless, total farmland prices remained relatively stable in the 2000s, likely due to increased demand for agricultural commodities. Our results are robust to different assumptions about the structure of the unobserved spatial correlation. (JEL Q15, R14)
abstract_zh: 本文利用2001–2010年俄亥俄州西部一个面临城市化压力的50县地区的地块层面农田销售数据，估计了2007–2008年住宅房地产市场崩盘对农田价值的影响。享乐价格模型估计结果表明，农田并未免受住宅房地产市场崩盘的冲击：在2009–2010年崩盘后不久，可归因于靠近城市地区的农田价值部分几乎减半。尽管如此，2000年代农田总价格基本保持稳定，这可能是由于农产品需求增加所致。我们的结果在关于未观测空间相关性结构的不同假设下依然稳健。（JEL Q15, R14）

title: Modeling the Determinants of Farmland Values in the U.S.
venue: Book chapter: The Oxford Handbook of Land Economics
abstract: Farmland has long represented a significant component of both farm sector and farm household assets. This chapter provides a comprehensive overview of significant developments in modeling farmland values, with attention to methodological challenges and recent modeling innovations. After outlining the capitalization model that provides the theoretical underpinnings for most farmland value studies, the merits and efficacy of dynamic models using aggregate data, as well as increasingly popular cross-sectional hedonic models that use spatially disaggregate data are presented. Estimation issues in hedonic models are reviewed, with a focus on those deserving special consideration in the context of farmland values such as spatial dependence and heterogeneity and sample selection bias. Promising future research directions include greater use of nonparametric approaches, quasi-experimental designs, panel data analyses, and structural econometric models, which take advantage of spatially explicit farmland values data but avoid the restrictive assumptions of standard spatial lag and spatial error models.
abstract_zh: 农田长期以来是农业部门和农户家庭资产的重要组成部分。本章全面概述了农田价值建模的重大进展，并着重介绍了方法论挑战和近期的建模创新。在阐述为大多数农田价值研究提供理论基础的资本化模型之后，本章介绍了利用总量数据的动态模型，以及日益流行的利用空间分解数据的横截面享乐模型的优点与效果。本章回顾了享乐模型中的估计问题，重点关注农田价值背景下尤其值得特别考虑的问题，如空间依赖性与异质性，以及样本选择偏误。未来有前景的研究方向包括：更多地使用非参数方法、准实验设计、面板数据分析，以及结构计量经济模型。这些方法能够利用空间明确的农田价值数据，同时避免标准空间滞后模型和空间误差模型的限制性假设。
